identifiedBy.fact: Starts at Corey's Road parking area

otherFacts.value: Rt 3 to Corey's Rd 2.5 mi, then gravel Ampersand Rd about 3 mi, lot on right
4.5 mi to Ward Brook Truck Trail, then right; herd path cairned just past Ward Brook lean-to

trailhead.name: Boston Basin Trailhead (Cascade River Road end)

identifiedBy.fact: INFERRED/WEAK: every Sharkfin approach page describes the Boston Basin approach; NPS 2017 report lists the South Face as a rappel option off the same basin; no page names this route's start

otherFacts.value: about 1 mi then steep trail into basin (search summary)

notes: Route name 'Flakes and Chimneys' found on no page. Inferred from the only approach in use (Boston Basin). WTA Boston Basin coordinate 48.5021,-121.0676 is the basin/hike listing, not the lot, so not offered as a placement. SummitPost 403 on fetch.

otherFacts.value: 7500, just beyond Vermilion Valley Resort
Devil's Bathtub, chute to divide, SW flank class 2
Onion Springs TH, Margaret Lakes camp, Rainbow Lake stream, steep talus, class 2 with some class 3
Vermillion Resort, Frog/Coyote/Baby Lakes, Rainbow Lake camp, west ridge class 2-3

notes: Two equally used starts: Lake Edison / Vermilion Valley Resort trailhead (2013, 2018 reports) and Onion Springs OHV-road trailhead (2002 report, about 5 mi up Onion Springs road off Kaiser Pass Rd). Nothing ties 'Standard route' to one. Wikipedia names no standard route. SummitPost 403.

trailhead.name: Silver Star Mountain trailhead (SR-20 pullout near milepost 165, first pullout after the Cutthroat Creek turnout)

identifiedBy.fact: Same as the Silver Star Glacier route to Burgundy Col

summitEvidence.fact: Route text: technical rock line up the west summit's northeast aspect; no top-out or descent stated

otherFacts.value: 4500 to 8876 high point (standard route)
the Bench about 6700 ft, or Burgundy col 7800

notes: WTA coordinate agrees with the route's own stored 48.549,-120.630965 (about 100 m). USFS 'Cutthroat Trailhead' is a different lot 1.7 km west. Summit reach left unknown: the text implies a summit line but never says it tops out.

trailhead.name: Depot Creek Road trailhead (off Chilliwack Lake Road, BC side)

identifiedBy.fact: Hard Mox climbed from a camp at the head of Depot Creek; Depot Creek Road turns off Chilliwack Lake Rd about 0.1 mi before a gated yellow bridge; trailhead about 2300 ft; locked gate at 0.9 mi; 5.5 mi to Lake Ouzel

otherFacts.value: 7200 ft divide at head of Depot Creek
locked gate about 0.9 mi up Depot Creek Rd

notes: Identification is for the peak's approach (Mountain Project says Beckey route camps at head of Depot Creek), moderately strong. No coordinate; WTA 48.9472,-121.2569 equals the peak, not a trailhead. Trailhead is in British Columbia, 16+ km from the peak; border crossing implied. Name only.
